title: An individual animal (DRAFT)
status: draft, published for comment on 16 October 2026 (SPEC 11.8)
description: One animal, logged by its breeder, its holder or a registry. Name, originator (the breeder or holder), taxon (the species), claimed creation date (the date of birth) and the sire and dam are envelope fields. This schema is the envelope's profileData; the fields a record's fingerprint covers are in x-veilcore.sealedFields. The fingerprint rules are SPEC 3.6.1 and 4.4, unchanged.

individualId.description: As written by the scheme that issued it. The holder's statement: that the ID belongs to the animal is for that scheme to say.

sealedFields.description: The committed fields of an animal record, exactly (SPEC 11.8): what its fingerprint is computed over, as the `fields` of an export's org.veilcore.registered-fingerprint extension carry them. Every field is present and none other; keyBinding is optional. One-line text has no control characters and no white space at either end (the pattern says so in JSON Schema's own terms; an implementation checks it as SPEC 11.8 states it). Cross-field rules a JSON schema can't state: species and breeder are not empty; name and individualId are not both empty; idScheme is empty exactly when individualId is; dateOfBirth is a real date; at most one sire and one dam, the sire first; a parent with no recordId has a name or an individual ID.

species.description: As the holder writes it, e.g. "Cattle (Bos taurus)". Not empty.

individualId.description: Exactly as written on its ear tag or registration, or empty. Never normalised.

idScheme.description: The scheme the individual ID belongs to, free text, e.g. "Japan cattle ID (10 digits)", "ear tag". Empty exactly when individualId is.

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real date, or empty. The holder's statement.

recordId.description: The parent's own record, when the holder logged it.

breeder.description: The breeder or holder. Not empty.

notOffered.claims: The claims of SPEC 4.5 are not offered: this profile defines no field set, and the distinct claim answers a question about varieties. Identity and parentage are a match or an exclusion a laboratory works out across two or three profiles; its signed report is what attests them.
notOffered.terms: Agreements, royalties and terms are not offered for animal records by the VeilCore web application yet.
